fields.locator: 10-Q Jun 30 2026 balance sheet: cash 1,253.205 + short-term investments 628.945

fields.note_en: Operating cash reserve at 3% of TTM revenue; a judgment.
fields.note_zh: 按TTM收入的3%设定的运营现金储备；属判断值。

fields.locator: 10-Q Note 7: 0% convertible notes due 2031, fair value at Jun 30 (principal 1,500, carrying 1,471.731)
fields.note_en: Fair value of the whole 2031 convertible, deducted once with no extra conversion shares.
fields.note_zh: 2031年可转债整体公允价值，仅扣除一次，不增加转换股。

fields.locator: 10-Q Notes 3/7 and cash-flow supplement: unpaid financing and excise costs
fields.note_en: Unpaid financing and excise costs at June 30.
fields.note_zh: 6月30日未付融资及消费税成本。

fields.locator: 10-Q Note 7: capped-call premium paid 88.9, equity-classified; cost used as asset proxy
fields.note_en: Capped-call premium paid, used as a cost proxy for the asset; no fair value is disclosed.
fields.note_zh: 已付封顶看涨期权费，作为资产成本代理值；未披露公允价值。

fields.locator: 10-Q balance sheet: long-term investments 8.0, carried at cost as the recovery proxy
fields.note_en: Carrying value of the private investment as the recovery proxy; not a fair value.
fields.note_zh: 非上市投资账面价值作为回收代理值；并非公允价值。

fields.locator: residualClaims 15; addendum says this allowance is unmeasured
fields.note_en: Allowance for remaining tax, capital and deferred-compensation claims; a judgment.
fields.note_zh: 剩余税务、资本及递延薪酬债权的准备金；判断值。

fields.locator: esppClaim 3; current ESPP rights not quantified in the 10-Q
fields.note_zh: 现有员工购股计划债权；判断值。

fields.locator: addendum: at-cost convention; paired purchase and asset legs net to zero
fields.note_en: Purchase and asset are valued at cost, so net present value is zero by convention, not a measured fair value.
fields.note_zh: 购买与资产均按成本计价，净现值按约定为零，并非实测公允价值。

fields.locator: 10-Q Note 5: FX forward asset 1.284 is not designated as hedge; net economics not specified
fields.note_en: Net FX exposure is not specified; gross asset is only 1.284.
fields.note_zh: 净外汇敞口未披露；账面总资产仅1.284。

fields.locator: FY2025 10-K: 484K nonvested RSUs/PRSUs at target at Jan 3 2026 (carried; 10-Q has no count)
fields.note_en: Nonvested RSU/PRSU units, millions; stale, and PRSU payout can reach 200% of target.
fields.note_zh: 未归属RSU/PRSU（百万股，按目标）；数据偏旧，PRSU最高可按目标200%兑现。

summary_en: June 30 cash, the 2031 convertible fair value, unpaid financing costs and the capped-call premium are from the 10-Q; the Rigaku and FX nets are set to zero by convention, and award units are carried from the 10-K.
summary_zh: 6月30日现金、2031年可转债公允价值、未付融资成本及封顶看涨期权费来自10-Q；理学与外汇净额按约定设为零，奖励股数沿用10-K。
